notes: Checked out during your shift? You can't check in again that day: the app asks you to inform HR, who corrects it. Your next time slot of a split shift and approved overtime still open as before.
Check Out before your shift ends now warns you first (on the phone and the kiosk): how early it is, that you can't check in again today, and to use Break Start for a break.
Half-day leave has no morning / afternoon choice any more: any approved half day lets you check in, with no early check-out warning that day.
Changes HR makes in aTAS Cloud to your punches, shift schedule or saved day reach the app within a few minutes (the kiosk also takes yesterday's punch fixes).
A shift ending at midnight, or a late check-out after midnight, is saved on the shift's own day.
Staff whose JET login can't read Daily Attendance now see their supervisor's adjustments.
Calculations match aTAS Cloud's latest rules (including a half day worked through the break, and a warning when a first check-in is past the absent limit).
